title: StorageOverview
description: The retained-work summary the Storage screen renders.

app_data_bytes.description: Bytes under the app-data directory, excluding the scratch override.

app_data_directory.description: The resolved app-data directory that owns manifests, logs, and the catalogue.

catalogue_bytes.description: Bytes occupied by settings and saved encoder definitions.

default_directory.description: The app-data default, shown as the target of "Use default".

free_bytes.description: Free bytes on the scratch volume, when it could be read.

log_bytes.description: Bytes occupied by run and application logs.

manifest_bytes.description: Bytes occupied by project and video manifests.

projects.description: One row per project that owns retained work, largest first.

retained_bytes.description: Bytes retained under every video's scratch directory.

temporary_directory.description: The scratch directory in use, whether it is the override or the default.

total_bytes.description: Total bytes on the scratch volume, when it could be read.

video_count.description: Total queue entries across every project.

StorageProject.description: One project's retained work, as the Storage screen lists it.

retained_bytes.description: Bytes retained under the project's videos.
